name: @epoch/mobile
description: Epoch Mobile Field Client (W018) -> Epoch Mobile Native Product (W049, ACR-005). The Expo + React Native Android/iOS field application around the W018 typed field-shell contracts, bound to the W046 shared product runtime: the app renders the W018 field surface (tenant-scoped capture sessions, versioned content-addressed replay-safe capture envelopes with MANDATORY uncertainty and unambiguous work-package linkage, photo/sensor/note evidence references by digest, field review/approval as W003 typed proposals) and talks to the SAME frozen 32-operation Application Gateway vocabulary through a typed client bridge (@epoch/client-runtime envelopes + the in-process @epoch/application-gateway binding; HTTP transport is the documented deployment seam). No second semantic store: observation/approval state flows through Gateway envelopes + client-runtime persistence/session seams; the offline queue holds PENDING PROJECTIONS of user intent only (the five W046 named negatives) and replays through the Action Gateway path with idempotency keys — exactly once. Session tokens persist ONLY through the platform secure store seam (never AsyncStorage/plaintext); camera/evidence capture is digest-addressed (the digest is computed BEFORE upload and the authority recomputes it server-side). Provider neutrality + determinism are preserved: zero wall-clock, zero randomness, instants caller-supplied. Mobile stack pinned by the Tech Lead via the workspace catalog: expo 57.0.26, react-native 0.87.1, detox 20.51.4 (catalog: protocol; the root manifest/lockfile are NEVER touched by this Work Order).
